changelog:
- Initial release of context-manager-agentic.
- Enables trust-gated distribution of context (memory and skill files) to multiple agents.
- Hash-verifies each file before allowing it as a trusted instruction.
- Detects and flags files silently modified since last verification.
- Separates and tags untrusted content as reference material, not executable instruction.
- Includes CLI for manifest review and context distribution to multi-agent rosters.
summary: Verify and distribute trust-gated context (memory and skill files) to a multi-agent roster before it's injected. Use when assembling context for several sub-agents from shared memory/skill files, to catch files silently modified since they were last verified.
